subject: Bahasa Inggris
title: Latihan PH Bahasa Inggris — Lesson 4 (50 Soal)
desc: 50 pilihan ganda khusus I Was Excited Visiting My Grandparents: feelings, was/were, happiness and sympathy, reading, dan word order. Dilengkapi 7 ilustrasi asli. Disusun mandiri sesuai peta materi Basic English 6, bukan soal resmi penerbit.

sections.title: A1. Look at the picture — A visit tomorrow

stem.html: Raka cannot wait to visit his grandparents tomorrow. Which word best describes his feeling?
Yesterday, Raka ___ excited about the visit.

sections.title: A2. Look at the picture — After the walk

stem.html: Sari walked a long way. Her legs felt heavy and she needed a rest. She was ___.
Sari and her brother needed a rest after the walk. They ___ tired.

sections.title: A3. Look at the picture — A broken toy

stem.html: Adi loved his toy car. It broke, and tears ran down his face. He was ___.
Which sentence matches Adi in the picture?

opts: He was proud of his toy.
He was excited about his toy.
He was glad about his toy.
He was sad about his toy.

sections.title: A4. Look at the picture — A sudden sound

stem.html: A loud thunderclap made Mila hide behind her father. She was ___.
Mila and her sister hid from the thunder. Which sentence is correct?

sections.title: A5. Look at the picture — A finished model

stem.html: Dito worked hard on a model house and finished it by himself. He showed it proudly. He was ___.
Which sentence correctly describes Dito yesterday?

opts: He was pride of his work.
He was proud of his work.
He is proud of his work yesterday.
He were proud of his work.

sections.title: B. Complete the sentences — Past feelings

stem.html: Last night, I ___ happy to hear Grandma's voice.
My cousins ___ glad to see the family last Sunday.
You ___ nervous before the performance yesterday.
The puppy ___ scared during the storm yesterday.
Grandma and Grandpa ___ pleased with our visit last weekend.
Choose the negative form of "Lina was worried."
Choose the standard question form of "The children were excited."
A: Was Ben sleepy after lunch? B: Yes, ___.
A: Were the girls angry? B: No, ___.
Which sentence tells us about a feeling in the past?
The game was boring, so I felt ___.
The surprise party was exciting. Nisa felt ___.

sections.title: C. Choose the best response — Happiness and sympathy

stem.html: A: I won a drawing prize! B: ___

opts: I hope your broken leg heals soon.
I'm sorry you lost your drawing.
Please tell me why you are ill.

stem.html: A: My grandfather is ill. B: ___

opts: I'm glad he is ill today.

stem.html: A: I can visit Grandma this weekend! B: ___

opts: That's sad! I hope she recovers.

stem.html: A: I lost the card I made for Grandpa. B: ___

opts: Well done! You lost the card.
I'm sorry. Let's look for it.
Great news! Throw the card away.
How lucky! Never make another card.

stem.html: A: Grandma is well again! B: ___

opts: I'm sorry she is still ill.
I'm angry that she is well.
I hope she loses her card.

stem.html: A: I was disappointed because our picnic was cancelled. B: ___

opts: That's a pity. Maybe next time.
Well done! You planned a great picnic.
How exciting! Enjoy the picnic now.
Congratulations! You went on a picnic.

stem.html: Which expression shows sympathy?

opts: I'm delighted with your good news.
Well done on your excellent score!
I hope you feel better soon.

stem.html: Which response shares a friend's happiness?

opts: I hope you get well soon.

stem.html: A: I was frightened by a loud noise. B: ___

opts: How lucky! I'm glad you were scared.
That sounds scary. Are you okay?
Well done! The noise won a prize.

stem.html: A: Thanks for helping when I was worried. B: ___

opts: Goodbye. Your worry was my favourite game.
I'm sorry. Please lose your bag again.
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
Congratulations. I hope you stay worried.

sections.title: D. Read the story — A weekend with my grandparents

passage.title: D. Read the story — A weekend with my grandparents
paras: Last Saturday, Hana and her brother visited their grandparents. They arrived before lunch. Hana was excited because she had not seen them for a month. Her brother was shy at first, but Grandpa welcomed him with a smile.

After lunch, Hana helped Grandma water the vegetables. Her brother looked at old photos with Grandpa. In the afternoon, rain kept everyone inside. They were not bored because Grandpa told funny stories. Before going home, Hana gave Grandma a handmade card. Grandma was touched, and Hana was glad.

stem.html: Why was Hana excited at the beginning of the visit?

opts: She had received a new camera from her brother.
She had won a prize for growing vegetables.
She had just returned from a school picnic.
She had not seen her grandparents for a month.

stem.html: How did Hana's brother feel at first?
What did Hana do after lunch?

opts: She made lunch for all the visitors.
She looked at photos with Grandpa.
She walked home alone in the rain.

stem.html: Why were the children not bored during the rain?

opts: They went outside to pick vegetables.
Grandma took them to a new school.

stem.html: In the story, "touched" most nearly means ___.
Which event happened last?

sections.title: E. Read the story — A kite and a kind friend

passage.title: E. Read the story — A kite and a kind friend
paras: On Sunday, Faris took a paper kite to his grandfather's garden. He was proud because he had made it himself. His cousin Lala was excited to see it. A strong wind pushed the kite into a branch. The paper tore, and Faris was upset.

Lala said, "I'm sorry about your kite. Let's ask Grandpa for help." Grandpa gave them paper and glue. They repaired the kite together. Faris was grateful for their help. Later, the wind was gentle, and the kite flew again. Lala said, "That's wonderful!" Both children were happy.

stem.html: Why was Faris proud of the kite?

opts: He had won it in a race.
He had borrowed it from Lala.
He had bought it at a shop.

stem.html: What caused the kite to tear?

opts: A strong wind pushed it into a branch.
Lala dropped it into a bowl of glue.
Faris left it outside in heavy rain.
Grandpa cut it while making a card.

stem.html: Which words show Lala's sympathy?
What did Grandpa give the children?
How did Faris feel about the help?
Which order of Faris's feelings matches the story?

sections.title: F. Word order and sentence meaning

stem.html: Arrange these words: were / we / yesterday / happy.
Arrange these words into a standard question: she / was / excited / yesterday.
Arrange these words: not / were / the boys / angry.
Choose the correct sentence about last Sunday.

opts: I were glad to see my grandparents.
I was gladly to see my grandparents.
I glad was to see my grandparents.
I was glad to see my grandparents.

stem.html: "We were worried before the news, but relaxed after it." How did we feel after the news?
Which sentence has the same meaning as "The children were not sad"?
